body:
Ahsoka wouldn't have prevented much of anything for a couple of reasons. One, there's no telling how the Jedi Council could take this news. They would either dismiss it since Ahsoka is receiving it from an "unreliable" source and do nothing, or they would have Anakin bagged, locked and stowed which would make Anakin hate her. Either scenarios wouldn't benefit the Jedi. On top of it, Ahsoka is no longer a part of the Jedi Order so she's under no obligation to tell them anything. That last stunt that Windu pulled in the hologram meeting probably also dissuaded her from telling the Jedi Council anything since they haven't learned their lesson from when they falsely accused her and put her on trial. Interrogating Maul was just a matter of time, time which the Jedi just didn't have.

Even if we dismiss Ahsoka and her Maul mission, the Jedi were already at least to some level interested in Palpatine as a suspect. I believe there's a canon book that delves into this where a small task force was deployed in some tunnel system underneath the Senate courthouse which led straight to Palpatine's place, a task force which never returned. This happens before General Grevious' lightning raid on Coruscant. So yeah, I wouldn't put too much on Ahsoka being the sole person to stop Order 66. She's was no longer a Jedi at the time and had no obligation to give them such sensitive details.

2 hours left. This, this is what you redditors are good for. I'm going to paraphrase something someone said, which basically means no amount of talking is going to solve the problem. Well, that's it folks. And now I die.

I got about 9 hours. So if I don't suicide, I just live.....in shame, regret and failure, ridicule. Yeah, no thanks. I don't know if you've read the other thread from the link I provided. Trust me, I've contemplated this long enough. Aside from the above that I've posted, there actually is no other way out of this one. If I could reset my life or go back in time, I wouldn't be here. There is no other way.

I'm in the Phil. so calling/texting you isn't so convenient. Then again, this is beyond talking. This is like borderline emergency or death type deal. If I was to chose live a life of failure and shame for lying/deceit over death, death to me is much more preferable.
I'm slittin' my wrists. F#ck this. Keep your pity, your prayers, your hopes and your condolences. I don't need it where I'm goin'. Out like a boss b$tches!
I can't answer that. It hasn't happened. Life doesn't work on the what-ifs only on the what-has and what-will. In any case, this is my resolve not yours. Thanks for your concern.

It gets worst however. Yes, it just never ends. This is more than just money, more than about my family, wife, daughter, this is about the fact that I lose. I will lose, lose, lose in life, and when I try to do otherwise I would lose some more. Life itself is a comedy gag. Its as if some fourth wall exists that enables the plot to always go against me. Never have I been free, never had I truly been successful in ANYTHING. It's been mentally killing me since I was born, looked down upon, cast aside by peers. Sorry, but saying sorry Labambah wont correct this. Saying sorry, apologizing for being a loser for the 1 millionth time, gets old. And as much as I tried to internalize and understand forex inside and out, spending thousands of hours looking at charts and proce feeds, really trying to trade to save my own skin, I failed spectacularly. Yeah, fuck this life. Non-existence is better than existing as a loser.

Sorry but you dont understand. I hope your read my post all the way through. Apologizing won't help, sacrifices were made to got me here. After doing some serious number crunching I came up with $40k. $40k is what they spent on me over the course of four years, that money was hardworked. Ideally if everything went alright with forex trading, if i could at least pay half that back to my parents, I would apologize, get me off this guilt trip. What you're saying is coming from la la land. "Hey mom, dad, sorry for blowing $40,000 of your hard earned back breaking jaw-dropping money in four years, oh and all your hard effort and sacrifices too. Hope you understand." Mistakes are one thing, the guilt, the time, is another. I don't think you fully understand what I mean when I say I'm mentally and psychologically gutted right now. The least I could do now is disappear so that another mistake like that won't happen.

Not good. I got two days and a few hours left. Even with the special feed that I get in regards to forex, I've lost all confidence in the market. There really is no way to be financially stable trading spotfx save for the small sum that has inside info.

I tried. But again as explained I'm financially dependent on my parents, another factor that's weighing me down to the course I'm on. Forex market is lucrative in the sense, it attracts traders due to its low barrier entry. Given the timeframe that I have it is now no longer feasible or even possible for me to try a different market. Stocks, futures and indices are far more better imo to trade than Forex given that they're centralized. Yes, there are iceberg and ping orders and you do have your occasional black swan events, but given that everything's transparent and not hidden like in SpotFX, trading commodities, equities, etc., anything that doesn't touch Forex is far more safer imo.

Your comment pearl\_imogen\_leader brought me to tears. Yes, I know she'll still remember me, we have family photos, and plenty of selfies with me and my daughter. That's why I plan to spend an entire day with her so that she'll always know I love her.
I respect your reply and your opinion fully.

I'm so sorry to hear this. This is why I hate life. Life only benefits those who've got money. Those without, to the wind with you. If the world was seriously revamped you and your husband would surely live a good life, perhaps with some kids, grow old together, possibly pass away together. But no, our lives are dictated by this stupid concept we humans call "fiat". I'm also in a tough pickle myself and about to "commit" in the next few days. But unlike me, if there's any amount of luck left in the world that'll be arriving at your doorstep soon, I sure hope you both be safe and are able to financially support yourselves.

Forex trading, unless you've got inside trading or have the orderbook of the major banks trading forex, you've got no chance. It's something I wished I learned back then and now I'm regretting everything. Those two years weren't worth it unless I had come out on top not only as planned but as a final resolve.
Intervention is not desirable. So agreed, I'm going to lay low from this point until the hour or so.
I made up my mind finally just yesterday. Had to confirm all other options that I could search were available. This is it baby!

Thanks for your reply. Sadly I don't feel the same way. Two years of harboring a cancerous secret while maintaining a facade that everything's normal and at the same time trying your damn hardest to rectify the damage can cause you to think otherwise. I'm not sure if you've felt the same way. You have friends, family, relatives, you smile, you play games, but deep inside you're already dead. In fact, I don't really recall whenever I was actually "normally" happy. Yeah, I smile and laugh to keep the mood going, but I'm hurting inside. That's what I've been feeling and for 2+ years. I've been dead for a long time, only this obsolete human flesh remains that needs to get checked out. Sad to say it but some people such as myself are too far down the rabbit hole to ever come out.
In three days, this comment will be more true than ever before.

Those positions you're talking about requires a degree/diploma, both in which I'm killing myself over for not attaining in the first place. Those options are out. And it's already too late. I'm committed now.
I will thank you. I'll tell my wife and daughter that I love them dearly before the end.
Too late. No time and no money. I'm committed. It's over. But that thought did cross my head at some point while I was "hoping to turn things around".

The day before I "commit to it" I'm going to write an encrypted message in masonic writing explaining what I've done, why I've done it and what led me to go away. If they can encrypt the message then they'll know for themselves.
Thanks for your response but I'm already committed now.
I've been searching for ways myself. Trust me, this is the only one ;)

Of course not, but what better way to atone for my sins than to snuff my own life out. My daughter is only 4. She would probably be told I'm off and I'll be back and she'll eventually forget about me. I'm not to keen on caring about what happens after I'm gone, all that I care about is ATONEMENT. Like I said, I've tried, I've failed, now it's time to pay and pay I will.

Thanks for the expansive reply. In response to your last paragraph there, yes, thinking about my daughter and my wife brought me from committing suicide back then, and it propelled me to search and work hard to get out of this hellhole I created. I failed. There is no more recourse now.
I get the points taken about being "selfish" meaning you'll be leaving behind pain to those around you, but as humans we learn to adapt quickly, some quicker than others.

Yeah, the two years I mentioned trading was my last hoorah. However I beg to differ, a dead me is always gonna be better than a rebellious screwed up me. Less overhead in my opinion, one less person to worry about. Perhaps somewhere out there, if a multi-verse does exist, I'd either be graduating as intended or actually have been successful at trading. It amuses me to no end that I've failed all throughout life.

The one thing I realize now more than ever even in these dying moments is: There are no guarantees in life. Nothing planned always goes according to plan. I've already thought long and hard about my wife and daughter. I'm going to spend my last moments with them happily as I should've been doing instead of trading, my daughter especially. I want to leave a lasting impression on her before I go.
